BASIC FUNCTION : Position has primary responsibility for the operational procedure and process associated with contractual arrangements/agreements for goods and services procured by the University. Also responsible for preaward and/or postaward functions for a variety of supply, service, and/or construction contracts for several activities within an organizational component or in a geographical area. The employee is responsible for a variety of contracts which frequently require special handling provisions or other specialized terms and conditions. Some contracts cover a period of more than one year. Typical requirements include technical equipment, supplies, construction, and services ranging from standard items which are complicated by urgent delivery requirements or security classification to complex or sophisticated requirements. Examples include equipment or services needed to support a research and development activity;
ADP equipment, softwareand related services;
conversion of installation functions from in-house to contract operations;
negotiated contracts with disadvantaged business firms;
contracts for PrincipalInvestigators and other specialized services and equipment for Research or a Hospital;
construction projects related to new buildings, roads, docks, and others which consist of standard design and specifications;
negotiation of contractmodifications and change orders caused by inadequate existing drawings, defective specifications, or changed site conditions;
alteration and repair projects such as those requiring the demolition and removal of existing walls and windows, relocation of heating and air conditioning systems, and modification of primary lighting and communication channels;
contracts for design and/or engineering services, other technical services, and technical equipment and supplies;
or contracts for acquisition and installation of building equipment systems.

SUPERVISORY

AUTHORITY: None

NATURE AND SCOPE :

Internal contacts include the Office of the General Counsel, executives, administrators, managers, faculty, staff and students of the University departments, units and offices. External contacts include Federal, state, local and other governmental sponsors of research/training programs at Howard University, private foundations, vendors, auditors, inspectors and other representatives working on behalf of program sponsors, representatives from other universities, institutes and other organizations with whom Howard University works on sponsored research/training programs and industry trade organizations (such as the National Contract Management Association and the National Council of University Research Administrators and others)

PRINCIPAL

ACCOUNTABILITIES :

Prepares documentation and legal draft of contracts/agreements, ensuring contract/agreement requirements are met, and works directly with Compliance Office and Office of General Counsel (OGC) to ensure contract/agreement language and requirements are appropriate and complies with Howard University and Hospital policies and procedures, and federal and state laws, to resolve compliance issues

Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive data at all times, including patient & student, and proprietary information.

Coordinates work with various departments and serves as a liaison between HU and vendors to oversee the intake, review and finalization of all contracts that bind the University.

Maintain University Contracts and systems to ensure timely renegotiation and consistency of language/terms in order to provide maximum legal coverage.

Examines the operational scope of contracts, working collaboratively with user departments to ensure compliance.

Serves as a consultant and educator to management and administrative staff relating to contract/agreement compliance requirements and issues.

Review and analyze contracts not requiring legal review and identify language issues and/or concerns.

Provides guidance to technical personnel involved in the development of the statement of work or data requirements. Formulates the contracting approach to be taken that will best satisfy the requirement.

In formally advertised procurements, ensures that the bid schedule is properly structured, prepares the solicitation, determines sources to be solicited, conducts prebid conferences, processes protests, determines the responsiveness of bids and determines the responsibility of the apparent low bidder based on an analysis of financial and technical information gained during the preaward survey, and awards or recommends award of the contract.

In negotiated procurements, the employee plans the procurement action with technical, legal, and contract pricing personnel. Provides guidance in the development of the statement of work and data requirements, determines the type of contract best suited to the requirement, develops special clauses and terms and conditions applicable to the solicitation. BASIC FUNCTION:

The Financial Aid Counselor provides excellent customer service and guidance to financial aid applicants and their families throughout the financial aid application process;
determines eligibility within the parameters of institutional, state and federal requirements.

SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY:

May be responsible for the supervision of student employees in the financial aid office.

NATURE AND SCOPE:

Internal contacts include students, faculty and staff. External contacts include families, prospective students, student advocates, and representatives of government agencies, lending institutions, guarantee agencies, community organizations, legislative representatives, and the general public.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Exercises independent judgment in the management of operational details of the financial aid process including but not limited to:
  • Provide advising throughout the financial aid process to prospective, new and current students and their families.
  • Reviews incoming financial aid application and any supporting documentation needed to determine the accuracy of the financial and household information reported on the FAFSA. This requires knowledge of not only federal financial aid regulations but IRS tax laws and how they relate to federal financial aid.
  • Complete assigned duties with a high degree of accuracy to ensure compliance while experiencing multiple interruptions.
  • Exercise great attention to detail when completing assignments as error in judgment or calculations could result in unintended consequences for the student and/or the institution such as under or over funding of a student, loss of student eligibility, audit findings, fines, damage to school’s reputation or loss of institutional eligibility.
  • Will have the authority to recalculate and makes changes to financial aid awards when student’s eligibility changes.
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state and institutional policies as it relates to the awarding and disbursements of federal, state and institutional aid.
  • Assists with the oversight of the administration of both the federal and private loans. This includes the certification of private education loans, resolving issues between the university’s system and the Dept. of Educations. Participation in state, regional and national professional development activities to ensure a complete understanding of federal and state regulations and remain current on changes to the federal and state aid programs.
  • Must utilize conflict resolution skill set to pacify disgruntled students and parents, helping them to understand the situation and identify potential solutions to issues.
  • Maintain student confidentiality in accordance with FERPA regulations.
  • Ensures that students are receiving Exit Counseling information upon withdrawal, graduation or dropping below half time.
  • Monitors TEACH grant eligibility;
    checks GPA after each semester, ensure required documents are complete, send TEACH Exit information, etc.
  • On an occasional basis, travel to an off-campus meeting site to attend institutional workshops;
  • Maintain work area in a neat and orderly fashion
  • Assist the management and other office staff in special project assignments;
  • Participates incommittees under the direction of the Manager of Financial Aid counselors to review Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) appeals, Professional Judgment requests, and Howard University Scholarship appeals, as needed.
  • May be required to work evenings and weekends
  • Other duties as assigned by the financial aid director/associate director and/or Manager of Financial Aid Counselors.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Must have a thorough knowledge of available types of financial aid, scholarships and general student eligibility criteria.
  • Familiar with financial documents and a high competency of computer skills
  • Proficiency in technology and the systems used to determine student’s eligibility and originate a financial aid award. (These may include but not limited to: Banner, NSLDS, COD, CPS, ELM, MS, School Servicing Center, Campus Logic, Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Ability to interpret complex financial aid regulations and apply appropriately in different situations
  • Understanding personal income tax laws as they relate to federal financial aid
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the ability to use sound judgment for decision-making

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s Degree and at least two years of experience in financial aid (or a related area) or the equivalent combination of education and work experience combined.

  • Apoiar e acompanhar pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro, elaborando peças jurídicas e revisando peças técnicas de suporte à defesa dos interesses da Concessionária;
  • Atuação na Revisão Ordinária do Contrato de Concessão;

  • Monitorar metase obrigações contratuais, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e indicadores previstos no contrato e em normativos regulatórios;

  • Experiência comdireito administrativo e regulatório;

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. title: Analista De Contratos Sênior
description:
Analista de Contratos Sênior

Join to apply for the Analista de Contratos Sênior role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare‑se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

  • You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! The newsletter covers new events, sponsorships, and upcoming tours. Optimize flows and automate email sequences.

description:
***Medical Science Liaison**** *Location:* Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte* *Field-based work model****At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.**We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).**Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.****Job Description:***We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in for T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.**Main responsibilities:****Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement** - Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships - Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment - Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols) - Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration - Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte
  • Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About youExperience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people's lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil's largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership
Important Notes Below

Always aiming for the safety and well-being of our employees, the COVID-19 vaccination certificate is an essential item for all employees, being present in the list of admission documents.

description:

Papel essencial em novos recursos, escalabilidade e boas práticas, atuando em infraestrutura AWS com foco em rastreabilidade e dados críticos. Vaga 100% remota, modelo de contratação é CLT. Inglês avançado obrigatório (interlocução com US).


O que procuramos:

O time de Engenharia busca Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Software para modernizar a plataforma e elevar a experiência do usuário. Atuação em novos recursos, escalabilidade e práticas de engenharia, desenvolvendo soluções em AWS que garantem dados e funcionalidades críticas aos clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar uma plataforma de rastreamento de ativos resiliente, confiável e altamente disponível.
  • Fornecer liderança técnica por meio do conhecimento e compreensão de design e arquitetura de software.
  • Aplicar práticas ágeis, incentivando a colaboração, priorização e urgência para um desenvolvimento acelerado.
  • Contribuir para a visão da equipe de Software, ajudando a evoluir práticas e ferramentas.
  • Construir parcerias multidisciplinares com gerentes de produto, engenheiros de dados, sistemas e qualidade, além de parceiros de negócios, para desenvolver funcionalidades para os clientes.
  • Buscar diferentes perspectivas para impulsionar a inovação e construir consenso dentro da organização de engenharia de software.


Conhecimentos e Habilidades:

  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.Js.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis híbridos para criar aplicações intuitivas e compatíveis com múltiplas plataformas.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, AWS e Postgres .
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST, GraphQL, micro frontends e microsserviços .
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software , incluindo definição de padrões, revisão de código, automação de testes, processos de build, monitoramento e alertas.
  • Capacidade de atuar com alto grau de autonomia, ao mesmo tempo em que trabalha em iniciativas estratégicas para a empresa.
  • Experiência com sistemas transacionais de alta demanda , onde desempenho e escalabilidade são essenciais.
  • Facilidade para aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias, auxiliando na transição para novas soluções.
  • Inglês Fluente
  • Experiência com a metodologia ágil Scrum em um ambiente de equipe distribuída.
  • Conhecimento em IoT, dispositivos de rastreamento e telemática é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Ruby on Rails é um diferencial.


Formação e Experiência:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • 7+ anos de experiência na área de Engenharia de Software.
  • Experiência demonstrada no desenvolvimento end-to-end de software, incluindo propriedade operacional .

title: Quality Control Analyst
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Quality Control Team play a critical role in maintaining data quality across the business. Data is at the core of our operations, and it is essential that this data is of a high standard at all times. The QC Analyst will work as part of the Commercial Team to drive data accuracy across the region, as well as being a part of the Global QC Team, sharing best practices, improvement initiatives and maintaining consistency across all regions. Attention to detail is paramount and strong communication skills are essential as there will be significant collaboration with other departments, in particular with the Recruitment and Service Teams.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Review Bullhorn records within the agreed timeframes and issue approval or query notes as appropriate. This may include Contract Placements, Change Requests, Perm/Direct Hire placements, GEM Placements, Client Records, Opportunity Records and Requirement Records.
  • Work with the relevant parties to ensure that any errors are corrected in a timely manner.
  • Produce reporting and analysis to provide key stakeholders with an accurate and up to date view of data accuracy across the region.
  • Hold regular QC review meetings with relevant departments to discuss any issues and identify key areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with other QC Coordinators, both regionally and globally, to share best practices and drive process improvement, in particular to deal with interregional placements efficiently.
  • Take a proactive approach to data clean-up e.g., updating fields in Bullhorn when a staff member leaves.
  • Support the QA/PIs with QC related process improvement projects.
  • Special adhoc projects, as directed by the Commercial Operations Manager.
  • Liaise closely with Payroll & Billing to ensure contract compliance relating to payroll and invoicing.
  • Work closely with Sales Team to ensure quality and contract compliance.
  • Ensure that Bullhorn and any relevant trackers are updated accordingly.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Fluent English.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Excellent technical skills including all Microsoft Office products.
  • Strong numerical skills.
  • Ability to problem solve.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to make decisions and prioritise objectives.
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work without supervision.
  • Able to handle demanding situations.

What we can offer you

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values:

  • Growth
  • In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth
    requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life
    – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence
  • We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity
  • We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more -

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultâneas;
  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo;

O que valorizamos em você:

A Zerezes nasceu do design, e da vontade de fazer diferente. A gente acredita que óculos são mais do que itens funcionais: são extensão de quem somos. Por isso, queremos transformar a forma como as pessoas se relacionam com eles.

O nosso jeito de trabalhar é leve, colaborativo e com propósito. Valorizamos quem tem curiosidade, busca aprender, se importa com o outro e quer deixar uma marca positiva por onde passa.

Aqui, cada pessoa conta. E a gente cresce junto, com transparência, impacto real e vontade de fazer bonito, sempre.

Fazer coisas memoráveis.

A gente gosta de fazer diferente, com criatividade, impacto real e propósito.

Abertura para aprender.

Somos curiosos por natureza. Escutamos, testamos, ajustamos e seguimos em frente.

Transparência radical.

Falamos com clareza e respeito. O combinado não sai caro, e o feedback aqui é ferramenta de crescimento.

Tratar os outros como gostaríamos de ser tratados.

Empatia e escuta são base de tudo. A gente constrói junto e valoriza cada ponto de vista.

Bom para o mundo.

Nosso impacto vai além dos óculos. Queremos gerar valor pra quem tá com a gente, seja dentro ou fora da Zerezes.

Vamos juntos?

Se você acredita que trabalho pode ser leve sem deixar de ser sério, que dá pra fazer bonito sem perder a simplicidade, e que ótica pode ser muito mais do que só vender óculos…

A Zerezes pode ser o seu lugar

  • Confiabilidade: análise preditiva, desenvolver FMEA (Análise de Modos de Falha e seus Efeitos)/RCM (Manutenção Centrada na Confiabilidade);
  • Melhoria Contínua: sugerir/participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos/procedimentos/sistemas considerando o desempenho, custo e risco;

  • Responder e elaborar controle de acompanhamento das demandas do ONS (SGP, Relatórios) e ANEEL (Ofícios);

  • Contribuir para obtenção de resultado, através de sinergia com as demais áreas da empresa. Respeitando os parâmetros de segurança e de meio ambiente;

Capacidade de gerar fluxo de caixa previsíveis a longo prazo.

Melhorar a sustentabilidade do mercado.

title: Backend Developer
description:
Magic Media is a pioneering media, entertainment and tech group powered by creativity and innovation. We have a physical presence in 15 countries and expertise in the areas of art, animation, cybersecurity, game development, software development, VFX and video production amongst others. We work with leading developers and publishers within the games and tech industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.

We are currently expanding our backend development team to support cutting-edge game and software projects. We're looking for talented C++ developers who are passionate about building robust, scalable, and high-performance server-side systems. As a Back End Developer, you will be embedded in the development team and participate in architecture discussions, technical meetings, and feature implementation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable back-end systems and server infrastructure using C++.
  • Implement and optimize game servers, APIs, and networking protocols
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following industry best practices.
  • Debug and resolve complex technical issues in production environments.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, game designers, and other team members to integrate systems.
  • Perform code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and server response times.
  • Implement security measures and data protection protocols.

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience in software development, with strong C++ expertize.
  • Demonstrated experience in back-end architecture and server-side development.
  • Proficiency in modern C++ standards (C++11/14/17 or later).
  • Experience with networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, WebSockets).
  • Knowledge of database systems, ideally Apache Cassandra.
  • Comfortable with version control systems (Git, Perforce).
  • Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming.
  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
  • Fluent in English.

DESIRABLE PLUSES:

  • Past experience of database migrations/upgrades.
  • Experience in the gaming industry or real-time multiplayer systems.
  • Familiarity with containerization and microservices architectures.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with performance profiling and optimization tools.

Benefits

  • Project-based remote position with a possibility for long-term engagement.
  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of engaging projects.
  • Be part of an international group with offices worldwide.
  • Career growth and development.
  • Working closely with a team of like-minded people in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • An inclusive culture and open communication.

At Magic Media, our passion lies in gaming. Our vision is to create and deliver engaging and interesting games for our clients. We can deliver this high-quality work on any platform, whether it be on a console, PC, or mobile. We know that reputation and results go hand-in-hand. Therefore, we work hard to find experts and talented creators to deliver the best results.

title: Automation Engineer, Electrical
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together


Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire an Automation Engineer, Electrical.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair, and maintenance work, including diagnostics, troubleshooting, and repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment, as well as electrical and control systems, across the MacGregor product range and third-party products, if needed.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e., the US,South and Central America, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities

  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to the company standards.

This role is part of our Global Services Division. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent.

What you'll need to succeed

title: Agentic Devops Engineer
description:
Company Overview


At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview


Community & Intelligence Engineering. The product is Assist Chat.

Job Description


Why This Role


Assist Chat is our flagship conversational AI for public safety—already live in 9-1-1 centers, patrol vehicles, and real-time crime centers. We've built the interface. We've embedded it into workflows. Now we're scaling the intelligence behind it.

This Agentic DevOps Engineer role is an opportunity to automate and enhance all stages of the software development lifecycle for products that push the frontier of how public safety professionals interact with AI.

Your Mission

  • Implement and manage AI-driven DevOps processes to automate and enhance every stage of the software development lifecycle, from planning to maintenance.
  • Deploy and oversee AI agents as autonomous team members capable of handling routine tasks, troubleshooting, and optimizing infrastructure.
  • Continuously monitor, refine, and optimize AI agent workflows to improve system performance, resource allocation, and application reliability.
  • Proactively identify and resolve system anomalies, leveraging self-healing infrastructure capabilities to maintain operational stability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI directly into real-time workflows—no labs, no "eventual" use cases.
  • Drive innovation by enabling engineering teams to focus on complex, strategic initiatives while AI agents handle repetitive and operational tasks.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers and responsible AI team to build the best possible AI solutions for our teams.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to communicate technical information effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with both local and remote teams
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, with a strong focus on automation, infrastructure management, and CI/CD processes.
  • 2+ years of experience with AI technologies or AI-driven tools, including their integration into development workflows.
  • Familiarity with LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Llama, etc.) and modern AI stacks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Ray, Hugging Face).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
  • Strong programming skills in Python development and testing (and ideally some experience working alongside full-stack engineers).
  • Proven ability to work independently, solve complex problems proactively, and improve processes through intelligent automation.
  • Pragmatism—able to operate in applied, real-world settings with real constraints.
  • Bonus: experience with AI safety, model evaluation, or regulated domains.

Why You Might Join

title: Project Engineering Lead
description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose
Develop and implement automated improvement solutions and new projects on equipment with automatic production processes, aiming for better operational performance and the lowest possible rejection rate, while complying with Quality, Safety, and Client Requirements standards.

Job Description

  • Responsible for leading Control and Automation Engineering in projects, being the single point for the scope, both internally and with the Customer.
  • Ensure functional requirements, quality, 'design for safety' and engineering delivery time are according to expectations.
  • Review and approve projects electrical, optical, hydraulic schematics, as well as related subsea distribution systems.
  • Generate, review, or approve Control System documentation within project, as specifications, schematics, test, and qualification procedures, among others.
  • Define project architecture solution to effectively comply with customer's requirements.
  • Lead sub-system Design Review, granting sub-system design freeze.
  • Participation in Design Review meetings, ensuring that the Client's requirements, quality, and good practices are met.
  • Creation and management of project activities and sub-activities, making sure execution complies with man-hours and technical solution budgeted.
  • Ensure the correct interfaces of control system equipment within project.
  • Grant the smooth stream among engineering, planning, procurement, project management, industrial engineering, and quality groups.
  • Location: Pavuna, RJ

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation or others
  • CREA
  • Good knowledge and experience on subsea control system engineering.
  • Knowledge of overall subsea production systems, specially control system.
  • Knowledge of International standards related to subsea control systems (API7F, API6A, etc.)
  • Knowledge of risk matrix and risk assessment capabilities.
  • Advanced English.
  • Intermediate Office package
  • Differentials:

Postgraduate degree in the Oil and Gas Engineering area, Subsea Production Systems or Control and Automation.

Having worked in the oil and gas sector, with experience in different scopes within control systems in a subsea project (e.g. control and automation cabin, HPU, electrical and hydraulic distribution systems, subsea controller, etc.).

title: Trader de Multimercado
description:
#VemSerMAG
A gestora nasceu em 2013 com o objetivo de administrar os recursos do Grupo MAG, e hoje entregamos soluções em investimentos para diversos clientes, sejam eles institucionais, corporativos ou plataformas digitais.
Em cada momento de nossa expansão mantivemos o compromisso com as práticas de governança corporativa, gestão de risco e transparência na política de investimentos, proporcionando confiança e serviços de qualidade.
A atuação fundamentada em sólidas estratégias de investimentos e forte relacionamento com os clientes, é a marca da nossa caminhada até aqui.
Desde 2017, reafirmamos a classificação do Rating de Qualidade de Gestão pela agência de risco Moody's, em 2022 tivemos a elevação da nossa nota para MQ1 (Excelente) e em 2024 fechamos o ano com, aproximadamente, R$16 bilhões sob gestão
.e políticos em nível local e global, até a tomada de decisão estratégica para alocação dos recursos.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 6,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.
Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Buscamos um Trader de Multimercado com foco em juros e moeda para fazer parte do time de gestão de fundos da MAG Investimentos.

Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você:

  • Graduação completa em engenharia, economia, administração, estatística, matemática ou áreas correlatas;

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Certificação CGA ou CFA;

title: Analista De Business Development
description:
Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We're focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

We look forward to meeting you

Job description

Junte-se à Amaris Consulting e comece uma nova jornada profissional em um ambiente internacional, dinâmico e com alto potencial de crescimento.

Na Amaris Consulting, ser Analista de Business Development significa atuar com a missão de construir e liderar o seu próprio portfólio de negócios. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de impulsionar sua carreira e contribuir para o desenvolvimento de uma organização global em plena expansão — além de se preparar para assumir posições estratégicas no futuro.

Como Gerente, você terá um papel multifacetado, atuando em três frentes principais:

Desenvolvimento de Negócios & Relacionamento com Clientes

Prospecção de novos clientes, mapeando o mercado e realizando abordagens ativas (cold calls e reuniões comerciais).

Apresentação de nossas soluções em tecnologia e engenharia, construindo relações de confiança com potenciais parceiros.

Gestão e expansão de contas ativas, garantindo a satisfação dos clientes e a criação de novas oportunidades.

Recrutamento & Gestão de Equipe

Atração e seleção de profissionais qualificados, com foco na combinação ideal de competências técnicas e comportamentais.

Acompanhamento, desenvolvimento e engajamento do time de consultores, promovendo um ambiente de crescimento e reconhecimento.

Garantia da entrega de projetos com excelência, mantendo a motivação e a satisfação da equipe alocada.

Gestão Financeira & Operacional

Acompanhamento do desempenho financeiro da sua unidade de negócios (P&L), com foco em rentabilidade e sustentabilidade.

Elaboração e execução de estratégias para otimização de resultados.

Organização das rotinas operacionais, promovendo uma cultura de alta performance.

O que você encontrará na Amaris Consulting

Um ambiente multicultural, com mais de 110 nacionalidades representadas globalmente.

Um modelo de carreira baseado na meritocracia, onde mais de 70% de nossos líderes iniciaram suas trajetórias em posições de entrada.

Treinamentos contínuos por meio de nossa Academia Corporativa, com mais de 250 módulos disponíveis.

Um ambiente colaborativo, com eventos internos frequentes (happy hours, team buildings, ações sociais).

Fortes compromissos com responsabilidade social corporativa (CSR), por meio de programas como o WeCare Together.

Requisitos

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente com pós-graduação ou mestrado em Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Interesse em atuar com gestão de negócios e pessoas, em um ambiente acelerado e desafiador.

Perfil estruturado, com raciocínio estratégico, espírito empreendedor e forte capacidade de execução.

Habilidades sólidas de comunicação verbal e escrita em português e inglês.

Na Amaris Consulting, valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo. Todas as pessoas qualificadas são bem-vindas, independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, crença, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Operações
description:
Sobre Agile HRO:

A Agile HRO é líder global em soluções de RH, Empregador de Registro (EOR), folha de pagamento e mobilidade global. Estamos crescendo rapidamente e expandindo nossa equipe para construir a plataforma de emprego global número 1 para empresas de alto crescimento.

Visão geral da função:

Buscamos um profissional de Desenvolvimento de Negócios, ambicioso e com foco operacional para impulsionar nossa expansão no setor de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Esta é uma função dupla: você será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de negócios para nossas soluções de EOR voltadas para clientes de energia e petróleo e gás, além de apoiar nossa equipe de Mobilidade Global com excelência operacional.

Você deve ser uma pessoa proativa e empreendedora, com profundo conhecimento do mercado de petróleo e gás do Brasil, e prospera na interseção entre vendas e execução. Você deverá saber como abrir portas, cultivar relacionamentos com a alta gerência e arregaçar as mangas para atender às necessidades dos clientes.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e executar uma estratégia de entrada no mercado para conquistar novos clientes EOR na indústria brasileira de petróleo e gás.
  • Identificar e envolver os principais tomadores de decisão (RH, CFO, jurídico, operações, C-suíte, compras, gerentes de projeto) nas empresas-alvo.
  • Construir e gerenciar um pipeline qualificado de clientes em potencial e converter leads em receita.
  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas, apresentar soluções de EOR da Agile HRO, preparar propostas e fechar negócios.
  • Fazer parceria com a equipe global de mobilidade para dar suporte aos processos de integração, documentação, visto e conformidade para novos contratados e funcionários destacados.
  • Atuar como especialista local em tendências de emprego, mão de obra e conformidade no setor energético do Brasil.
  • Apoiar projetos multifuncionais que melhorem nossa entrega operacional para os clientes.
  • Representar a Agile HRO em eventos do setor, conferências e no ecossistema de petróleo e gás.
  • Trazer ideias criativas e inteligência de mercado para nos ajudar a crescer 5x na região.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B, desenvolvimento de negócios ou gerenciamento de contas, de preferência em RH, EOR ou serviços de mobilidade global.
  • Histórico comprovado de vendas para clientes de petróleo e gás, energia ou indústria pesada no Brasil
  • Profundo networking e conhecimento do cenário de petróleo e gás brasileiro e dos principais players.
  • Operacionalmente forte: você deve entender como passar da "Apresentação à entrega" e participar ativamente para garantir o sucesso do cliente.
  • Fluente em português e inglês.
  • Mentalidade empreendedora, com viés para ação e resultados.
  • Orientado para o crescimento, perseverante e capaz de trabalhar de forma autônoma em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado.
  • Altamente organizado, com fortes habilidades de gerenciamento de projetos e engajamento de partes interessadas.

Pontos de bônus:

  • Experiência em vistos, imigração ou operações de mobilidade global.
  • Compreensão da legislação trabalhista brasileira e conformidade de RH.

Por que Agile HRO?

  • Ambiente de alto crescimento com oportunidades de avanço na carreira.
  • Junte-se a uma equipe global de profissionais de primeira linha que estão transformando o futuro do trabalho.
  • Cause um impacto tangível impulsionando o crescimento e a excelência operacional em um mercado crítico.


About Agile HRO:

Agile HRO is a global leader in HR, Employer of Record (EOR), payroll, and global mobility solutions. We are growing fast and scaling our team to build the #1 global employment platform for high-growth businesses.

Role Overview:

We're seeking an ambitious, operationally-minded Business Development professional to drive our expansion in Brazil's oil & gas sector. This is a dual role: you'll own business development for our EOR solutions targeting energy and oil & gas clients, while supporting our Global Mobility team with operational excellence.

You are a proactive self-starter with deep knowledge of Brazil's oil & gas market, and you thrive at the intersection of sales and execution. You know how to open doors, nurture C-level relationships, and roll up your sleeves to deliver on client needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy to win new EOR clients in the Brazilian oil & gas industry.
  • Identify and engage key decision makers (HR, CFO, legal, operations, C-suite, procurement, project managers) at target companies.
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of prospects and convert leads into revenue.
  • Drive sales meetings, pitch Agile HRO's EOR solutions, prepare proposals, and close deals.
  • Partner with the global Mobility team to support onboarding, documentation, visa, and compliance processes for new hires and deployed employees.
  • Act as the local expert on employment, labor, and compliance trends in Brazil's energy sector.
  • Support cross-functional projects that improve our operational delivery for clients.
  • Represent Agile HRO at industry events, conferences, and in the oil & gas ecosystem.
  • Bring creative ideas and market intelligence to help us 5x growth in the region.

Who You Are:

  • 4+ years' experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, ideally within HR, EOR, or global mobility services.
  • Proven track record selling into oil & gas, energy, or heavy industry clients in Brazil.
  • Deep network and knowledge of the Brazilian oil & gas landscape and key players.
  • Operationally strong: you understand how to move from "pitch to delivery" and are happy to get hands-on to ensure customer success.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias for action and results.
  • Growth-driven, tenacious, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly organized with strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in visas, immigration, or global mobility operations.
  • Understanding of Brazilian employment law and HR compliance.

Why Agile HRO?

  • High-growth environment with career advancement opportunities.
  • Join a global team of A-players transforming the future of work.
  • Make a tangible impact driving growth and operational excellence in a critical market.

title: Driller
description:
*1.0 VACANCY REQUIREMENTS
JOB TITLE: Driller
REPORTING TO: *
Toolpusher/Tourpusher

LOCATION:
Offshore

Please Read This Section First:
To be considered for this role, at a minimum the candidate must possess the following licenses and/or training, which will have a least
6 additional months
of validity at the time of CV submittal:

  • OGUK or STCW compliant Health Certificate.
  • Basic Safety Training (OPITO approved BOSIET, STCW Basic Training w/HUET, or CBSP w/HUET is the minimum requirement)
  • IWCF Well Control, Driller, Combined, Level 3 *Note: Some training schools are not acceptable. Seadrill will make final determination upon reviewing candidate's credentials.
  • Please ensure that relevant certificates and licenses are submitted at the same time as the candidate CV
  • Special Requirements/Restrictions to be listed here:
  • If this section is blank, no additional or special requirements other than standard industry experience for the role and rig type

The candidate must possess the relevant technical experience for this role, and additionally possess:

  • A strong leadership and communication ability
  • A good ability to speak, read and write English
  • A strong sense of accountability and ownership for performance and safety of crew and rig

All candidates who pass initial CV screening and possess the basic certifications and licenses are required to complete online psychometric assessments. The results will be used by Seadrill as part of overall screening.

  • Assessments must be completed prior to any further screening or interviews.
  • Candidates will be notified via email if they are chosen to take the assessment.
  • The assessment needs to be completed within 5 days in order to ensure an efficient and timely screening process. If the candidate is not able to take the assessment within that time period, please let Seadrill know.
  • It is critical that the candidate read and follow the directions that are sent with the assessment link. Failure to follow the instructions may result in lower assessment results.

*1.1ROLE SUMMARY *
Responsible for the safe and efficient execution of all well and drilling activities and actively supervise the drilling crew.

1.2QHSE
Responsible For /ensure:

  • Compliance with the Seadrill Code of Conduct.
  • Compliance with applicable internal and external governing requirements.
  • Compliance with applicable laws.
  • That all relevant personnel are adequately trained in handling emergencies.
  • That all emergency equipment is in good condition and configured as required.
  • Non-compliances are promptly acted on and reported to the direct supervisor.
  • All relevant governing documents are revised as and when required.
  • Compliance with the standard for tidiness and cleanness.
  • Assume the safety role as per station bill and emergency preparedness plan.
  • Contribute with OBS card reporting.

Assist With:

  • verifying client drilling program vs. Seadrill requirements
  • Seadrill training, certification and competence compliance management

Participate In:

  • Meeting activities in a proactive and constructive manner.
  • Training and competence assessments as assigned and/or required.

1.3JOB SPECIFIC
Responsible For /ensure:

  • And owner of the well integrity at all times.
  • Directing all activities related to drilling operations in accordance to the drilling program.
  • Monitoring the well bore condition, interpret and respond to down hole conditions.
  • Securing of the well during an emergency or well control situation.
  • Executing well kill operations as per instructions from Seadrill supervisors .
  • Conducting well and drilling activities as directed by the Tool pusher/Tour pusher.
  • The drill floor is never left unattended when connected to a well.
  • All relevant governing documents are adhered to by direct reports.
  • All relevant governing documents are revised as and when required.
  • That clear daily operational guidelines are provided to all direct reports.
  • V isible leadership by spending time in the field and monitoring daily operations.
  • All drills and checks are conducted as required.
  • All applicable reports and logs as required by supervisors, client and company.
  • Assist with preparation for future drilling operations.
  • Thorough handovers are provided at each daily change of shift.
  • Subordinates are trained in order to make them suitable for a higher position.
  • Other duties are performed as and when required and/or directed by his/her direct supervisor.

1.4EQUIPMENT & SYSTEMS
Responsible For /ensure:

  • Operational preparedness of all safety and emergency equipment.
  • That the first line maintenance of drilling equipment is performed and recorded.

1.5AUTHORITY

  • As per Corporate and Regional specific Delegation of Authority matrices.

*1.6QUALIFICATIONS *

  • As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

*2.0 REGIONAL REQUIREMENTS *
This section describes requirements deemed necessary for this position in the respective region and are considered as additions to the requirements outlined in Section 1.

The requirements in Section 1 are to be considered minimum corporate requirements and deviations from same are to be handled in accordance to the Directive for Handling of non-conformities.

title: médico clinico
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do
Hospital Municipal Pedro II
.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O
Centro de Tratamento de Queimados
é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar consultas no pronto atendimento, unificando dados contidos em prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos; passar em visita aos pacientes internados, avaliando a recuperação dos mesmos; efetuar pequenas intervenções cirúrgicas que não exijam corpo clínico especializado; encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou título de Especialização na área

Registro ativo no conselho da classe

Experiência em Urgência e Emergência

Experiência em Clínica Médica

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
We Offer
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities
Instructional Design:

  • Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training's standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.

Team Leadership:
